purpose: Freeze one source-backed, default-off GLONASS FCN provenance/admission adapter without authorizing implementation or raw execution.

candidate.scope: Read-only provenance/admission and Observation FCN annotation at the existing selected-ephemeris/transmission-time boundary.

route_inventory_sufficiency.reason: Sealed metadata has GLO body-row/header counts and finite nav-domain facts, but no per-satellite geph.frq, toe/tof, time-window coverage, or duplicate/conflict evidence.

permitted_sources_in_order: RINEX observation GLONASS SLOT / FRQ # header entry for the exact satellite
broadcast GLONASS ephemeris geph.frq selected for the exact satellite and existing FGO query time
provenance_policy.header_priority: header FCN is the primary provenance value when present
provenance_policy.header_present_geph_rule: selected time-valid geph.frq must exist and equal the header FCN exactly
provenance_policy.header_missing_rule: selected time-valid geph.frq is the only permitted fallback; no base-frequency or guessed channel
provenance_policy.missing_source_rule: missing header plus missing selected geph, or header present plus missing selected geph, fails closed
provenance_policy.mismatch_rule: header FCN != selected geph.frq fails closed
provenance_policy.invalid_rule: non-integer, nonfinite, or out-of-range FCN fails closed
provenance_policy.out_of_validity_rule: no geph outside the existing GLONASS validity window may supply a channel

fcn_semantics.rtklib_header_encoding: nav.glo_fcn = fcn + 8; zero is the absent sentinel
fcn_semantics.native_nav_normalization: RINEX navigation value >128 is reduced by 256 before strict admission

ephemeris_selection.query_time: existing second-pass FGO transmit time after pseudorange and satellite-clock update; no new iteration
ephemeris_selection.ranking: minimum abs(query_time - toe) among valid records for the exact satellite
ephemeris_selection.rtklib_time_api_caveat: RTKLIB convenience frequency/wavelength helpers are satellite-based and have no time argument; native time-aware selection supplies the explicit query-time provenance boundary.

header_duplicates.same_fcn: accepted as consistent duplicate and counted
header_duplicates.different_fcn: header conflict; fail closed before map collapse
header_duplicates.malformed_entry: fail closed for a required satellite; never silently infer

ephemeris_ties.same_minimum_age_same_fcn: accepted as consistent duplicate and counted
ephemeris_ties.non_tied_records: existing minimum-age selection remains authoritative; no merge or rerank
ephemeris_ties.invalid_or_out_of_window_records: not candidates; if no valid candidate remains, fail closed

duplicate_and_conflict_policy.observation_interpolation: missing or unequal FCN metadata is never blended into a synthetic channel; existing interpolation policy remains unchanged

official_cache.claim: header FCN path, missing sentinel conversion, and separate nav-backed sat2freq path
RTKLIB RINEX observation read and nav.glo_fcn export
RTKLIB sat2freq wrapper receives nav and returns per-satellite/code frequency
RTKLIB code2freq delegation and -7..6 FCN warning boundary
geph.frq integer plus toe/tof are exported/imported
GLO frequency base/steps and PRN domain

official_upstream.claim: GLONASS header fcn+8 encoding and signed nav frq normalization/range diagnostic
satellite-specific GLONASS wavelength uses geph.frq and base/step frequency

native.claim: header map parse and broadcast GLONASS FCN normalization
1800-second GLONASS validity and minimum-age satellite/time selection
ephemeris/observation FCN frequency formulas and base fallback when metadata is absent
existing two-pass transmit-time and selected ephemeris boundary
GNSS-first selected ephemeris boundary and unequal channel interpolation guard

fixed_invariants: Phase126 source-complete raw-base operator and exactly-once correction remain unchanged
C7/D/CCDD topology, units, initialization, exact-key handoff, and coverage remain unchanged
GNSS/IMU/carrier/TDCP/Doppler factor families and admission remain unchanged
MULTIFRONTAL_QR, ordering, whitening, sigmas, filters, Huber, LM schedule, and iteration limits remain unchanged
Pixel5 final output offset, timestamp/output alignment, solution opacity, and truth separation remain unchanged
legacy/default path is byte/semantic unchanged when Phase127 selector is absent
forbidden_lineage_and_actions: fixed GLONASS channel or zero-channel default
phone coordinate, result coordinate, base station table, or precomputed correction
MAT, PDC, truth, accuracy, Kaggle, or token access
raw payload read before a new independent authorization
solver launch before per-satellite/time geph inventory passes
rerun, fallback, extrapolation, endpoint hold, nearest fill, repair, or sweep

planned_files: src/algorithms/fgo_problems.cpp and GNSS-first admission boundary only
planned_implementation_and_tests.atomicity: No partial selector. Header/geph validation, exact-key annotation, and telemetry admission must all pass before any factor/correction mutation.
focused_tests: header present and selected geph same FCN accepted
header absent and selected geph boundary FCN -7 or 6 accepted
missing satellite, no geph, invalid flag, or abs(query-toe)>1800 fails closed
FCN -8, 7, nonfinite, nonintegral, malformed, and bad normalization fail closed
same-FCN header/geph duplicates accepted and counted; differing-FCN ties/conflicts fail closed
no channel synthesis through interpolation, fixed zero, base frequency, Android frequency, or external table
route preflight emits compact missing/conflict coverage and does not launch solver

future_authorization_requirements.new_pre_raw_manifest: required; pin source, implementation, selector composition, route paths/hashes, and forbidden lineage
future_authorization_requirements.pre_solver_inventory: required after authorization; header ledger, nav geph.frq/toe/tof, selected query-time validity, duplicate/conflict and exact GLO key coverage
future_authorization_requirements.fail_closed: any missing, invalid, out-of-window, mismatched, conflicting, unresolved, nonfinite, or unproven channel; no solver launch
future_authorization_requirements.truth_authorization: separate later authorization required; not granted here
